about: Fixture trees for `gash hte migrate`, generated by executing the real HTE code paths (no hand-typed templates except where noted). Each variant dir is a fake filesystem root: etc/apache2/{sites-available,sites-enabled,certs-selfsigned}, etc/php/<ver>/fpm/pool.d, etc/hosts. Paths INSIDE files are the real absolute paths (/etc/apache2/certs-selfsigned, /var/run/php/...). sites-enabled entries are relative symlinks ../sites-available/<name> as a2ensite creates them. Placeholder identity: user=dev group=dev, docroot=/home/dev/sites/<name>/public. Certificates/keys are real throwaway self-signed material produced by HTE's own cert script (2048-bit RSA, sha256, 10950 days, SAN *.d + d). expected-discovery-1.1.1.json = what hte-cli 1.1.1 ApacheManager::getVhostsList()+PhpFpmManager::getConfByDomain()/detectProfile()+needsLocalhostBypassFix() return on that tree (paths relative to the tree root). expected-discovery-1.1.0.json = same with the v1.1.0 phar sources (Malformed: expected-discovery-1.1.0.crash.txt, 1.1.0 dies with TypeError).
generator: work/hte/render/gen.php (V1 via phar of tag v1.0.12 = 6edce81 app/Logic/Daemons/Apache2.php + app/Logic/Preprocessors/Php.php; V2 via v1.1.1 = 8e18711 app/Services/ApacheManager.php + PhpFpmManager.php + PhpProfiles.php)

V1.versions: hte-cli 1.0.0 .. 1.0.12 (first build 13e6f93 = 1.0.2, tags v1.0.8 3fb5050 .. v1.0.12 6edce81); templates unchanged since 8126180
V1.vhost_marker: # Auto-generated by the test environment creator on <Y-m-d H:i:s>
V1.force_block: 4-space-indented comment '# Auto-generated Force HTTPS' followed by 3 directives at column 0, no localhost bypass
V1.pool: no '; Profile:' line, no comments/blank sections; 'php_value[short_open_tag] =  On' (two spaces)
V1.date: comment date is UTC (config/app.php timezone UTC); fixtures use 2024-05-06 07:08:09

sites.001-http.test: HTTP only (only reachable via 1.0.0-1.0.3 --ssl=n flags or hand edit)

V1-fixed.versions: V1 tree after `hte-cli fix` of 1.1.0 (a195f84) / 1.1.1 (8e18711); only 003-forced.test.conf differs from V1
V1-fixed.force_block: comment replaced by '# Auto-generated Force HTTPS (bypassed for localhost requests)' and all 6 lines re-indented with the comment's original indent (4 spaces); vhost marker stays the V1 marker

V2.force_block: all 6 lines at column 0 (flexible-heredoc indentation stripping), with localhost bypass
V2.pool: '[domain]' then '; Profile: <dev|staging|hardened>' plus commented sections; http.test=dev, https.test=staging (PHP 7.4), forced.test=hardened
V2.hosts: each create appends "\n127.0.0.1    <d> www.<d> # hte-cli\n" (4 spaces after the IP)

Broken-bypass.versions: NOT produced by any tagged release (inferred: an unreleased 1.0.13 dev build that README sample output still shows, or hand edits); shape copied from the author's regression test tests/Unit/ApacheManagerTest.php:608-634

files.001-broken.test.conf: 4-space indent, two blank lines between directives (test shape)
files.002-broken0.test.conf: column 0, one blank line between directives

Broken-bypass.expected-after-fix/: byte-exact output of ApacheManager::fixLocalhostBypass() 1.1.1 on each file

Malformed.versions: inputs that 1.1.1 must skip (44033ae); 1.1.0 crashes with TypeError on the first null domain

files.000-default.conf: non-HTE vhost (no marker): ignored by discovery but its 000- prefix still counts for the next NNN index
files.020-.conf: marker, no SetHandler (exact content of 1.1.1 regression test) -> skipped
files.023-nocert.test.conf: V1 marker, <VirtualHost 127.0.0.1:443> block without SSLCertificate*File -> 1.1.1 ssl=false (1.1.0 ssl=true, cert=null)
files.024-quoted.test.conf: hand-edited quoted DocumentRoot with a space -> 1.1.1 docroot '/home/dev/sites/my quoted/public'; pool has '; Profile: custom' -> profile falls back to dev
files.025-valid.test.conf: valid control site; NOTE its pool resolves to etc/php/7.4/fpm/pool.d/aaa-notes.conf because that file contains the substring '[valid.test]' in a comment and is visited first (defect: pool ownership by substring; result depends on readdir order of RecursiveDirectoryIterator, on the generating machine etc/php/7.4 was visited before etc/php/8.3)
files.etc/php/custom/fpm/pool.d/orphan.test.co: pool outside a <ver> dir -> skipped by getConfByDomain
files.etc/php/8.3/fpm/pool.d/nocert.test.conf: '; Profile: HARDENED' -> detectProfile lower-cases to hardened (1.1.1)

variants.cert-script/sscert_site.test.sh: the exact bash script create/modify write to $TMPDIR/sscert_<domain>XXXXXX, chmod 0755 and execute as root; identical text in 1.0.x (app/Logic/Bash/Scripts.php) and 1.1.x (app/Services/SslCertManager.php)
variants.templates/: tokenized renders ({domain},{docroot},{phpver},{user},{group},{date},{certsdir}) of every template: v1-vhost-{http,https,forced}.conf, v1-pool.conf, v2-vhost-{http,https,forced}.conf, v2-pool-{dev,staging,hardened}.conf; produced by work/hte/render/tok.php running the real getConf() code
